C-TABLE-BAR-MENU-OVERLAP.Name: Table drag-pill menu overlap fix — implementation plan
C-TABLE-BAR-MENU-OVERLAP.IntentSummary: Make the TableBarTools context menus single-line-safe in every locale: one CSS edit in src/muya/lib/ui/tableTools/index.css (content-driven width with a 150px floor plus li white-space: nowrap, the blockViewer pattern) proved by a new red-first e2e geometry spec (tests/e2e/table-bar-menu.spec.ts) that opens both pill menus in ru and en, asserts per-item one-client-rect / scrollHeight == clientHeight and the width floor/growth, and runs in the chromium and webkit-tables projects; M-012 / V-M-012 gain the routing lines; acceptance artifacts (before/after screenshots of both menus in both locales) land in the bundle evidence directory; full unit and chromium e2e gates close it.

MustPassCommand.Command: npm run build && npx playwright test tests/e2e/table-bar-menu.spec.ts --project=chromium

C-1.Name: One line, always
C-1.Expected: Opening the row-pill and column-pill menus in ru (and en as control) shows every item as one text line: each li.item has scrollHeight equal to clientHeight and its text range produces exactly one client rect; no label is clipped, truncated or painted over a neighbour in either engine.

C-2.Name: Growth with a floor, en untouched
C-2.Expected: The measured menu width is at least 150px in en — the en menu geometry (item count, heights, divider, placement) is visually unchanged — and strictly wider than 150px in ru, wide enough for the longest label on one line.

C-3.Name: Positioning follows the menu
C-3.Expected: After the menu widens, the popper keeps it anchored beside its pill (right-start, offset unchanged) for both the row pill and the bottom pill inside the table-scroll sticky-footer layer; Escape and outside-click still close it; the remove-item divider keeps its designed geometry against single-line 25px items.

C-4.Name: Nothing else changed
C-4.Expected: No JS, locale string, BaseFloat or sibling-menu CSS changes ship; the existing table e2e families, the full unit gate and the full chromium e2e gate stay green; grace lint reports no new findings against the recorded pre-existing baseline.

T-001.Title: Red-first e2e geometry spec for both pill menus in ru and en

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: tests/e2e/table-bar-menu.spec.ts carries the house MODULE_CONTRACT header (PURPOSE/SCOPE/DEPENDS tauri-shim+helpers/LINKS V-M-012/ROLE TEST/MAP_MODE LOCALS) and a C-TABLE-BAR-MENU-OVERLAP marker, and boots the editor twice — ru via the mt_prefs_get_all language override, en as the shim default.

For each locale it activates a table (ag-active), clicks .ag-drag-handler.left and .ag-drag-handler.bottom, waits for the .ag-table-bar-tools float, and asserts per item: scrollHeight === clientHeight, the label text range yields exactly one client rect, and the menu offsetWidth is >= 150 (and > 150 for ru after the fix).
Against the current CSS the ru cases fail (wrapped two-line items measured — the red proof is recorded in the change Evidence) while the en cases pass, isolating the defect.
The spec runs under both the chromium project and, via the table-*.spec.ts match, the webkit-tables project without workflow changes.

Verification.Command: npm run build && npx playwright test tests/e2e/table-bar-menu.spec.ts --project=chromium

T-002.Title: CSS fix: content-driven width with 150px floor + nowrap items

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: .ag-table-bar-tools drops the hard width: 150px for width: max-content with min-width: 150px, and li.item gains white-space: nowrap; a short comment with the change id records why (long-locale labels must never wrap into the fixed-height items).
Nothing else in the file changes: item height/line-height 25px, hover, the remove-item margin-top and ::before divider rules stay byte-identical; no other CSS file is touched.
The T-001 spec passes in chromium for both locales (ru items single-line, menu grown past 150px; en unchanged), and the BaseFloat resize-detector repositions the wider menu without JS changes.

T-003.Title: Engine parity and owner acceptance artifacts

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The spec passes in the webkit-tables project (the WKWebView engine the macOS build ships) — the same table-UI engine-sensitivity precedent as the resize families.

Before/after screenshots of both menus in ru and en land in .grace/changes/active/C-TABLE-BAR-MENU-OVERLAP/evidence/ (the «before» pair from the 2026-11-09 diagnosis, the «after» pair captured post-fix on the same doc), giving the owner the visible overlap-to-clean pair.

Evidence-only sibling re-measure: one probe pass over the front menu (and imageToolbar label surfaces if any text label exists) in ru records whether any sibling float menu carries the same fixed-height wrap trap; a real finding becomes a filed follow-up change, not a scope creep here.

T-004.Title: Graph and verification routing: M-012 / V-M-012

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: .grace/graph/runtime.xml M-012 (muya) gains the C-TABLE-BAR-MENU-OVERLAP routing line (tableTools menu geometry now locale-safe, CSS-only) and .grace/verification/runtime.xml V-M-012 gains the scenario for the new spec (ru/en both pills, one-rect-per-item, width floor/growth, both engines), placed per the existing entry conventions.

grace lint --change C-TABLE-BAR-MENU-OVERLAP --assertions target is clean of new findings (the recorded pre-existing baseline — sideBar/tree-treefiles, worktrees, missing C-NOTIFICATION-SYSTEM spec — is unchanged by this bundle).

npm test (full unit gate) is green; the full chromium e2e gate (npm run test:e2e, which re-runs the new spec alongside the existing table families) is green on a fresh build — no new failures or flakes attributable to the wider menu.
The bundle records the Evidence (red proof from T-001, both-engine green runs, screenshot artifacts, sibling re-measure result) ready for the final assertions run and archive.
